source.citation: Cui et al., Nature Communications 17, 697 (2026), Supplementary Note 8 and author source data; Krutyanskiy et al., PRL 130, 213601 (2023); Dhara et al., PRA 105, 022623 (2022); Bennett et al., PRL 76, 722 (1996); Deutsch et al., PRL 77, 2818 (1996); Clark et al., PRL 127, 130505 (2021); Ballance et al., PRL 117, 060504 (2016); Myerson et al., PRL 100, 200502 (2008)
source.parameter_location: Cui Supplementary Note 8 and Zenodo FIGS7.xlsx sheet c J/K, N=41 weak-cavity two-photon projection; Krutyanskiy/Dhara fixed-resource asynchronous repeater recipe; cited calcium-ion local operations
source.mapping_status: Cui detector-conditioned elementary lanes inserted into the Krutyanskiy/Dhara fixed-resource rolling and purification architecture; not demonstrated as an integrated chain

validity.distance_semantics: distance between neighboring calcium-ion nodes; the midpoint BSM has two equal half-edge arms
validity.route_scope: Cui source-data anchor has 12 km node-to-midpoint arms (24 km node separation); 1--50 km edge evaluation applies only explicit C-band attenuation and herald-latency scaling

hardware.resource_semantics: four fixed purification lanes per adjacent edge side; each lane has two independent four-communication-ion Cui hybrid raw-generation modules and two raw memory slots. A degree-two node therefore reserves 64 communication and 16 memory ions. This copies fixed modules and queues their accepted outputs; it is not a route-availability optimizer.
hardware.resource_source: Cui demonstrates four communication ions per hybrid-multiplexed node; the fixed replicated-module inventory follows the Krutyanskiy/Dhara rolling-resource recipe and lies within Dhara's analyzed tens-to-hundreds-ion regime

rate_model.source_data_location: Cui author dataset DOI 10.5281/zenodo.17590282, FIGS7.xlsx, sheet c, cells J6/K6
rate_model.rate_semantics: per raw-generation module aggregate ion-ion renewal rate after the Cui correlated repeated-excitation/shuttling mode train and midpoint two-photon BSM; the profile never substitutes the demonstrated 4.28/s one-node ion-photon rate
rate_model.distance_mapping: R(D)=R(24 km)*10^[-0.2*(D-24 km)/10]; D is total neighboring-node fiber, so this is the joint two-arm transmission scaling
rate_model.projection_boundary: the weak-cavity operating point is an author-simulated compatible component projection, not the demonstrated free-space 12 km ion-photon apparatus

state_model.service_estimate_calibration: conservative empirical fit to the repository Cui 866->1558 detector-conditioned Fock/PNR one-edge kernel: Bell fidelity 0.9999968734/0.9999961498/0.9999946793/0.9999903051 at 1/10/24/50 km; active scalar 0.99998 is below the worst sampled value and is used only for analytic purification acceptance and pre-storage service diagnostics
state_model.elementary_state_semantics: the histogram retains its full detector-conditioned density operator and does not apply Cui's scalar ion-photon tomography fidelity as a second memory channel
state_model.interface_uncertainty: Cui reports scalar ion-photon Bell fidelities but not a constructor process matrix; those values remain validation benchmarks rather than an invented Pauli channel

local_single_qubit_gate_model.source: Ballance et al., PRL 117, 060504 (2016), 0.066(3)e-3 error at 7.5 us

bell_basis_transform_model.mapping_semantics: Clark's uncorrected Bell preparation is used as a conservative reciprocal Bell-transform classification envelope

readout_model.mapping_semantics: two fluorescence bits identify the complete local Bell outcome

local_swap_model.compatibility: Cui and Clark use calcium-ion optical-qubit control; the integrated multi-zone node requires local recalibration but no species transduction

memory_model.detected_decay_semantics: Cui mid-circuit detection converts D5/2 decay into heralded loss in the rolling availability, not conditional-state noise
memory_model.purification_wait_semantics: two independent aggregate raw renewals are modeled exponentially; the exact |X1-X2| exponential wait law is averaged through Cui's Gaussian memory coherence

controller_model.accepted_output_alive_time_semantics: fixed post-purification rolling staleness cutoff, not an optimized availability target
controller_model.scheduling: Krutyanskiy/Dhara fixed-resource recipe: independent Cui raw modules feed four purification lanes per edge, accepted outputs fill rolling pools, and deterministic local Bell measurements execute in a balanced nested tree

notes: Operational restoration of the Cui rolling lane. Cui supplies the correlated hybrid-multiplexed midpoint-link projection and protected memory; Krutyanskiy/Dhara supply the fixed-resource rolling reservation recipe; the existing noisy LOCC and calcium-ion local BSM close purification and swapping. The demonstrated Cui node profile remains separate and unchanged.
